## Text fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/text-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `email` | Text field with email format validation (RFC 5322). Validates email addresses and prevents invalid formats from being stored. |
| `long-text` | Multi-line text input for paragraphs, descriptions, notes, and comments. Supports line breaks and longer content without rich formatting. |
| `phone-number` | Text field for storing phone numbers with support for international formats. Numbers are stored as plain text without automatic formatting. |
| `rich-text` | Stores formatted text with rich formatting support. Rendered with Tiptap WYSIWYG editor in UI. |
| `single-line-text` | Short text input limited to a single line. Ideal for names, titles, labels, and brief identifiers. Text is stored as-is without formatting. |
| `url` | Text field with URL format validation. Validates web addresses and supports multiple protocols (http://, https://, ftp://, etc.). |

## Numeric fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/number-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `currency` | Specialized numeric field for monetary values with currency codes (ISO 4217). Uses exact DECIMAL storage to prevent rounding errors in financial calculations. |
| `decimal` | Numeric field for numbers with decimal places. Supports configurable precision (1-10 decimal places) and min/max range validation. Uses exact DECIMAL storage. |
| `integer` | Numeric field for whole numbers without decimal places. Supports min/max range validation and is optimized for performance. |
| `percentage` | Specialized numeric field for percentage values (0-100). Values automatically display with % symbol in UI. Supports configurable decimal precision. |
| `progress` | Displays percentage value as progress bar. Used for tracking completion status or goals. |
| `rating` | Allows rating values with configurable maximum. Typically rendered as stars or other indicators. |

## Date and time fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/datetime-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `created-at` | Automatically captures the timestamp when a record is created. System-managed field that cannot be manually edited. |
| `date` | Stores date and optionally time values. Supports custom formats, timezones, and time inclusion. |
| `datetime` | Stores timezone-aware timestamps. Used for event times, deadlines, and appointments with ISO 8601 format. |
| `deleted-at` | Captures the timestamp when a record is soft-deleted. NULL indicates the record is active. Enables soft delete with record restoration capability. |
| `duration` | Stores time duration values. Used for tracking elapsed time or work hours with custom formats. |
| `time` | Stores time-only values without a date component. Used for schedules, opening hours, and time slots. |
| `updated-at` | Automatically updates the timestamp whenever a record is modified. System-managed field that updates on every change. |

## Selection fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/selection-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `checkbox` | Boolean field for true/false values. Typically rendered as a checkbox in the UI. |
| `multi-select` | Allows selection of multiple options from predefined list. |
| `single-select` | Allows selection of one option from predefined list. Used for categories or enumerated values. |
| `status` | Status field with colored options for workflow states. |

## Relational fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/relational-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `lookup` | Displays values from related records without aggregation. |
| `relationship` | Links records to another table with referential integrity. |
| `rollup` | Aggregates values from related records using functions like SUM, AVG, COUNT. |

## Media fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/attachment-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `barcode` | Stores barcode values with various format support. Used for product identification and inventory. |
| `multiple-attachments` | Stores multiple file attachments. The storage backend is configured globally through STORAGE_* environment variables, not per field. |
| `single-attachment` | Stores a single file attachment. The storage backend is configured globally through STORAGE_* environment variables, not per field. |

## User fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/user-audit-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `created-by` | Automatically captures the user who created a record. System-managed field that stores user ID reference. |
| `deleted-by` | Automatically captures the user who soft-deleted a record. System-managed field that stores user ID reference. NULL when record is active or deleted by system process. |
| `updated-by` | Automatically captures the user who last modified a record. System-managed field that stores user ID reference. |
| `user` | Reference field linking to users from authentication system. Supports single or multiple user selection. |

## Advanced fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `array` | Stores arrays of values with optional type and length constraints. |
| `autonumber` | Auto-incrementing number field assigned by the database. |
| `button` | Interactive button that triggers actions like opening URLs or running automations. |
| `code` | Stores source code as plain text with syntax highlighting. Rendered with CodeMirror 6 editor in UI. |
| `color` | Stores color values in hexadecimal format. Rendered with color picker in UI. |
| `count` | Counts the number of linked records from a relationship field. Optionally filters records before counting. |
| `formula` | Computed field that calculates values based on formula expressions. |
| `geolocation` | Stores geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude). Used for location-based features. |
| `json` | Stores structured JSON data with optional schema validation. |

## AI fields

Read: `sovrium docs fields/ai-fields`

| Type | What it stores |
| --- | --- |
| `ai-categorize` | Automatically classifies records into exactly one category from a predefined list using AI analysis of source fields. |
| `ai-extract` | Pulls structured data from unstructured text into JSON using AI analysis, validated against a user-defined JSON Schema. |
| `ai-generate` | Produces free-form text from a prompt template with {{fieldName}} variable substitution and source field context. |
| `ai-sentiment` | Analyzes emotional tone of text content, returning structured JSON with label (positive/negative/neutral/mixed), confidence score (0-1), and explanation. |
| `ai-summary` | Automatically summarizes content from source fields into concise text. Supports configurable max length and custom prompts. |
| `ai-tag` | Automatically assigns multiple labels from a predefined set using AI analysis. Output is a text array of matching tags. |
| `ai-translate` | Automatically translates content from a source field into a target language using AI. |
